summaries: A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release (September 20, 2022) reporting monthly new residential construction statistics for August 2022. Relevant to the task: It supplies the initial Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) figures for total housing starts (1,575,000) and total housing completions (1,342,000) for August 2022, marking the start of the requested 2022/08 to 2025/05 analysis window. Although the document contains historical data back to January 2022, only the August 2022 data falls within the task range. The figures are marked preliminary ('p'), meaning they are subject to revision by subsequent reports in the collection, consistent with the task's requirement that the most recent report prevails for conflicting values.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release titled "Monthly New Residential Construction, September 2022," issued October 19, 2022. Relevant to the task: It supplies the Seasonally Adjusted Annual Rate (SAAR) data for Total Housing Starts and Total Housing Completions required to calculate the 'construction pipeline fill rate.' Specifically, it provides figures for September 2022 (Starts: 1,439,000; Completions: 1,427,000) and revised data for August 2022 (Starts: 1,566,000; Completions: 1,345,000). As the initial release for this period, it covers the start of the requested 2022/08–2025/05 timeframe, but these values are preliminary (September) or revised (August) and subject to supersession by later reports in the collection per the task's conflict resolution rule. The document does not contain data for the remainder of the period beyond September 2022.

A U.S. Census Bureau and HUD press release dated November 17, 2022, titled "Monthly New Residential Construction, October 2022."
